sanskrit: lokānāmiṣṭadātā'bhayalasitakaraḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārī vāṇī tasyānanābje vilasati satataṃ jñānasandohalakṣmīḥ vāyormaṇḍalamatra dhūmasadṛśaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaśobhānvitam pāṇibhyāmabhayaṃ varañca dadhataṃ lokatrayāṇāmapi mattā pūrṇasudhārasārdrahṛdayā kaṅkālamālādharā maulau sūkṣmavibhedayuṅmaṇiriva prollāsalakṣmyālayaḥ vācāmīśvara īśvaro'pi jagatāṃ rakṣāvināśakṣamaḥ lakṣmī raṅgaṇadaivataṃ parapure śaktaḥ praveṣṭuṃ kṣaṇāt himacchāyānāgopari lasitatanoḥ śuklavarṇāmbarasya sadāpūrvo devaḥ śiva iti ca samākhyānasiddhiprasiddhaḥ mahāmokṣadvāraṃ śriyamabhi mataśīlasya śuddhendriyasya ścirañjīvī jīvī niravadhivipadāṃ dhvaṃsahaṃsaprakāśaḥ vidyāṃ mudrāṃ kapālaṃ ḍamarujapavatīṃ bibhratī śubhracittā vedānāmādibījaṃ sthiratarahṛdayaścintayettat krameṇa dīrghāyuḥ so'pi kartā tribhuvanabhavane saṃhṛtau pālane ca stadādye nādo'sau rasadhavalasudhādhārasantānahāsī statastanmadhyāntaḥ pravilasitarūpānapi padān 'vyayaḥ sākṣī vahneḥ śaśimihirayormaṇḍala iva purāṇaṃ yogīndraḥ praviśati ca vedāntaviditam stadā vācāṃ siddhiḥ karatalakamale tasya bhūyāt sadaiva lalāṭādyairvarṇaiḥ parilasitavapuḥkevalānandarūpam tadantaḥ śūnyaṃ tat sakalasuragaṇaiḥ sevitañcātiguhyam svarūpī sarvātmā rasavirasamito'jñānamohāndhahaṃsaḥ parīvāho haṃsaḥ parama iti nāmnā paricitaḥ munīndrā apyanye prakṛtipuruṣasthānamamalam

sadā kartuṃ hartuṃ khagatirapi vāṇī suvimalā pūrṇānandaparamparātivigalatpīyūṣadhārādharā candrārddhāṅgasamānabhaṅguravatī sarvārkatulyaprabhā sarveṣāṃ jīvabhūtā munimanasi mudā tattvabodhaṃ vahantī keciddhaṃsākhyametat kimapi sukṛtino mokṣavartmaprabodham bhittvā talliṅgarūpaṃ pavanadahanayorākrameṇaiva taptām mokṣākhyānandarūpaṃ ghaṭayati sahasā sūkṣmatālakṣaṇena yogīśo gurupādapadmayugalālambī samādhau yataḥ yogī yogaparamparāviditayā brahmāṇḍabhāṇḍe sthitam pūrṇānandaparamparāpramuditaḥ śāntaḥ satāmagraṇīḥ stasyāvaśyamabhīṣṭadaivatapade ceto narīnṛtyate yogavivaraṇaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ prakāśaḥ hastamātramitaṃ sūtraṃ parito lāñchayettataḥ caturasraṃ bhavet kuṇḍaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam nyasettasyā nyaset sūtre pārśvayormadhyamāvadhi pṛthak pṛthag yathā samyak tathā koṇatrayāvadhi uttarābhimukhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ yonyākhyaṃ siddhidāyakam trikoṇakuṇḍamākhyātaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam tadā vṛttaṃ bhavet kuṇḍaṃ prācīmukhamanuttamam ekamekaṃ tato dadyād vāmadakṣiṇakoṇayoḥ tanmadhyādūrddhvamānāntaṃ sūtramekaṃ nipātya ca yāmye tanmāraṇe śastamuttarābhimukhaṃ sadā madhyād vṛttatrayaṃ kuryādādyabhāge tu karṇikām tadbāhye'ṣṭadalāgrāṇi kalpayeddeśikottamaḥ adhobhāge keśarāṇi padmakuṇḍaṃ samīritam

pañcadaśāṅgulaṃ khātaṃ ramaṇīyantu kārayet kuṇḍānāṃ yādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ mekhalānāñca tādṛśam daśahastāntamanyeṣāmarddhāṅgulaṃ pṛthak pṛthak tadbāhya-mekhalotsedhamaṅguladvitayaṃ bhavet vedāgnipakṣavistārāḥ kartavyā mekhalāḥ śubhāḥ kartavyamathavā khātaṃ dvādaśāṅgulasammitam ucchritā mekhalāḥ sarvāścaturaṅgulavistṛtāḥ khanet ṣaḍaṅgulotsedhā mekhalā vedavistṛtā athavā sarvakuṇḍaṃ hi khaneddhastaikamānataḥ yāvat kuṇḍasya vistāraḥ khananaṃ tāvadīritam athavā tritayī kāryā vedāgninayanāṅgulaiḥ uttamā madhyamā nyūnā krameṇa parikīrtitāḥ aratrimātrakuṇḍe tu tri-dvyekāṅgulasaṃyutāḥ mekhalā dvikare kuṇḍe rasa-vedaguṇāṅgulāḥ daśāṣṭāṅgāṅgulairjñeyā rasahaste tu mekhalāḥ utsedhāyāmato jñeyā mekhalāḥ sarvato budhaiḥ aśvatthapatrarūpāṃ vā trikoṇāṃ vā vicakṣaṇaḥ ekāṅgulantu yonyagraṃ kuryādīṣadadhomukham ekaikāṅgulato yoniṃ kuṇḍeṣvanyeṣu varddhayet dvādaśāṅguladīrghāntu tathāṣṭāṅgulavistṛtām daśahastāntakaṃ mānaṃ pūrvavad varddhayet kramāt tridvyekāṅgulavistāraṃ kramānmūlāgramiṣyate muṣṭyaratnekahastānāṃ nābhirutsedhabhāvataḥ yavadvayakrameṇaiva nābhiṃ pṛthagudāradhīḥ yonikuṇḍe tyajed yonimabje nābhiṃ vivarjayet

patrāṇi vilikhedaṣṭau bahiraṃśadvaye sudhīḥ hastamātraṃ sahasre tu dvihastamayute tathā samantād varddhayettena kuṇḍaṃ tat syāddvihastakam evameva vidhānena tat sarvaṃ varddhayet sudhīḥ atha toḍalatantrasya matamanyat pracakṣyate varddhayettena mānena dvihastañca pracakṣyate aṣṭahastaṃ koṭihome daśahastaṃ tathaiva ca lakṣāṇāṃ daśakaṃ yāvattāvaddhastena varddhayet daśahastāt paraṃ kuṇḍaṃ nāsti sarvāgameṣvapi vakrakuṇḍe tu santāpo maraṇaṃ chinnamekhale kuṇḍasya rūpaṃ jānīyāt paramaṃ prakṛtervapuḥ udaraṃ kuṇḍamityuktaṃ yoniḥ pādau ca paścime yonikuṇḍaṃ vākpradaṃ syādākṛṣṭikaraṇaṃ bhagam padmākhyaṃ sarvasampatteḥ kāraṇaṃ puṣṭidaṃ bhavet vaṇijāmarddhacantrañca tryasrantu śūdrajanmanām ācāryāḥ kathayantyeke sarveṣāṃ caturasrakam apatyadhvaṃsanaṃ proktaṃ kuṇḍaṃ yat kaṇṭhavarjitam nityaṃ naimittikaṃ homaṃ sthaṇḍile vā samācaret athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi sruksruvasya ca lakṣaṇam gṛhītvā vibhajeddhastamātraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatā punaḥ ekāṃśena mitaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ saptabhāgamitaṃ mukham kaniṣṭhāṅgulimānena sarpiṣo nirgamāya ca vidadhīta bahistasyā ekāṃśenābhito'vaṭam mekhalā mukhavedyoḥ syāt parito'rddhāṃśamānataḥ ṣaḍbhiraṃśaiḥ pṛṣṭhabhāgo vedyāḥ kūrmākṛtirbhavet

mukhasya pṛṣṭhabhāge'syāḥ saṃproktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ srucaḥ dvāviṃśatyā daṇḍamānamaṃśairetasya kīrtitam aṃśadvayena nikhanet paṅke mṛgapadākṛti pūrvavacca sruvasyaiva lakṣaṇaṃ samudāhṛtam sruksruvāṇāmabhāve tu prakārāntaramucyate athavāśvatthapatrābhyāṃ saṃkṣipte homakarmaṇi saptamaḥ prakāśaḥ ādau kuṇḍasya saṃskārānaṣṭādaśa ca kārayet tenaiva tāḍanaṃ darbhairvarmaṇābhyukṣaṇaṃ matam hṛdayenāstramantreṇa samīkaraṇameva ca mārjanaṃ varmamantreṇa tataḥ kuryādvilepanam trisūtrīkaraṇañcaiva hṛnmantreṇa prapūjayet catuṣpathabhāgarūpaṃ nayanenākṣapāṭanam āhavanīyaṃ tato'nvāhāryaṃ dakṣiṇadeśataḥ catuṣṭayaṃ vā mūlena vīkṣaṇañca śarānunā prokṣaṇaṃ kavacenaiva saṃskārāśca samīritāḥ aṅguṣṭamadhyamotsedhavālukāmayamaṇḍalam śodhanaṃ kārayet sthānaṃ vīkṣaṇādicatuṣṭayaiḥ prādeśamātraṃ vijñeyaṃ mukundeśendrarūpiṇam rekhātrayaṃ tathā brahmavaivasvatendurūpakam rajastāsāṃ samuddhṛtya prokṣayet praṇavena tu dhānyapiṣṭena vā madhye cūrṇena vā haridrayā likhitvā bālayā puṣpaṃ tanmadhye ca vinikṣipet maṇḍūkaṃ pūjayedrūdramādhārakūrmaśūkarān a-pūrvāṃsteṣu koṇeṣu pīṭhasyopari pūjayet

punastāreṇa mantrajño yogapīṭhaṃ yajettataḥ yogapīṭhaṃ ṅenamo'ntaṃ pīṭhamantro'yamīritaḥ kāmeśvarīṃ mahāprauḍhāṃ nīlendīvarasannibhām śaktibījena kāmeśīṃ kāmeśaṃ sādhyamantrataḥ araṇīsambhavaṃ vāpi kṣiptaṃ svarṇādibhājane athavā'nītamabhitaḥ sthāpayet kāṃsyabhājane tasmāt samānayet kiñcid vahnibījena yājakaḥ prokṣayet kavacenaiva tathā-vaguṇṭhanaṃ caret daśadigbandhanaṃ kṛtvā dhenumudrāṃ pradarśayet kūrcāstrābhyāñca nairṛtyāṃ kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajet śvāsamārgeṇa manuvit kavacena tato'rcayet caitanyaṃ ṅe namo'ntaṃ syādanenotthāpayecchucim ātmano'bhimukhaṃ kṛtvā pūrvoktamaṇḍalāntare sarvajñājñāpaya svāhā vahniṃ prajvālayet sudhīḥ imāñca jvālinīṃ mudrāṃ darśayet sādhakottamaḥ suvarṇavarṇamamalaṃ samiddhaṃ sarvato mukham kāmabījaṃ samuccārya vahnimūrtiṃ samarcayet kāmeśvaryā garbhadeśe vahnimanena bhāvayet jihvāyāṃ devatā nyaset svaliṅgagudamūrddhāsya-nāsānetrāṅgake kramāt caturthyantāḥ ṣaḍaṅgeṣu yojayet kramaśaḥ sudhīḥ agninā saha sarvatra manuvijjātavedasam viśvamukhaṃ devamukhameṣu sthāneṣu vinyaset vāmapāyau tasya deśe pārśvāṃśe kramato nyaset svaliṅgagudamūrddhāsyanāsānetreṣu sarvataḥ

bindunādakalāyuktā jihvāmantrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ jihvāstāstrividhāḥ proktā guṇabhedena karmasu bahurūpātirūpā ca sāttvike yāgakarmaṇi rajoguṇasamuddiṣṭā rasanāḥ kāmyakarmasu etāḥ sapta prapūjyante krūrakarmasu mantribhiḥ svasvanāmasamābhāḥ syujihvāḥ kalyāṇaretasaḥ arghyodakena cābhyukṣya madhyasthamekhalopari uttarāgraṃ paścime tu prāgagramuttare kramāt asyopari sicet toyairmūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥ prādakṣiṇyena sampūjyāsteṣu brahmādimūrtayaḥ varadābhayaśobhāḍhyaṃ suvarṇavarabhūṣaṇam trinetramujjvalaṃ dhyāyedūrddhvamauliṃ jaṭādibhiḥ lohitākṣa ca sarvānte karmāṇyatha ca sādhaya tanmukhe rasanāṃ yajet pūrvoktamantrayogeṇa ṣaḍaṅgāvaraṇaṃ yajet punarvaiśvānaraṃ dhyātvā pūjayet sādhakottamaḥ praṇītāprokṣaṇīyugme jalapuṣpe vinikṣipet ādāya vāmahastena dūrvayā mārjayet tridhā ātmano dakṣiṇe bhāge sthāpayedāstare kuśe pavitraṃ tatra saṃsthāpya kuryādīśamukhaṃ sudhīḥ kṛtvā cāṅgārakaṃ vāyau ghṛtamadhye vinikṣipet hṛdayena ca mantreṇa dyotanaṃ samudīritam aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāntu tat pavitrañca dhārayet tamagnau kṣepayedājyaṃ bālayā chābhimantrayet mekhalāsu ca sarvāsu dīpamālā niyojayet

saprādeśaṃ darbhayugmaṃ granthiyuktaṃ ghṛte kṣipet iḍāṃ dakṣe piṅgalāñca suṣumṇāṃ madhyabhāgataḥ juhuyādagnaye svāhetyagnerdakṣiṇalocane juhuyādatha somāya svāheti hṛdayāṇunā juhuyādagnīṣomābhyāṃ svāheti hṛdayāṇunā juhuyādagnaye sviṣṭikṛte svāheti tanmukhe ityagnernetravaktrāṇāṃ kuryādudghāṭanaṃ guruḥ mahāvyāhṛtihomañca tārādyena caturhunet bhuvaḥpadād vāyave ca antarīkṣāya śabdataḥ svarādityacandramasau ṅentau nakṣapadāttataḥ bhyasantaścaiva digbhyaśca mahate vahnivallabhā brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe'bhyarcya vidhivat sādhakottamaḥ idamagneḥ karomyetad garbhādhānamataḥ param hutvā saptāhutīrevaṃ samidhaḥ kṣepaṇaṃ tathā jātakarma samāpyātha nālāpanodanāya ca oṃ kāmeśvara-kāmeśvarībhyāṃ svāheti ca nirvapet iṣṭadevasya nāmnā tu vahnernāma samācaret cūḍopanayanaṃ caiva samāvartanameva ca vivāhañca śubhe kārye krūrakāryeṣu māraṇam nyāsakrameṇāṣṭamūrterhomaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ juhuyādagnimantreṇa vauṣaḍantena sampade juhuyācca caturvāraṃ samaste naiva tena tu bhinnenaiva samastena tanmantraśca nigadyate pañcāntakaṃ binduyutaṃ ṅentaṃ gaṇapatiṃ tataḥ me vaśamānaya svāhā viṃśatyantagajāntakaḥ

sāmānyaṃ sarvadevīnāṃ mukhametat samīritam vibhāvyāvāhayeddevīṃ śrīmattripurasundarīm ājyena juhuyānmantrī vaktraikīkaraṇaṃ tvidam nāḍīsandhānamuddiṣṭametadāgamavedibhiḥ saṅkalpañca tataḥ kṛtvā kāmyahomaṃ samācaret juhuyājjvalite vahnau saṃkhyāñca paritaścaret yadi kāmī bhaveccaiva śūdro'pi homakarmaṇi vārāhītantrarājasya matametadudīritam uccāṭe vāyujihvāyāṃ madhyasthāyāntu māraṇe vilvākṣaśīgrughaṭitaṃ māraṇoccaṭanādiṣu tisro mudrāḥ smṛtā home mṛgī haṃsī ca kasturī mṛgī kaniṣṭhātarjanyau tyaktvā mudrātrayaṃ smṛtam yajñe śāntikakārye ca mṛgī haṃsī prakīrtitā śāntau vaśye tathā stambhe vidveṣoccaṭamāraṇe bālābījairyathānyāyaṃ śrīvidyāṃ pūjayet tataḥ ghṛtena srucamāpūrya puṣpamagre nidhāya ca yavarūpāṃ huned dhārāṃ jayaghoṣapuraḥsaraiḥ ātmārpaṇena manunā hunedaṣṭāhutiṃ kramāt itaḥ pūrvamiti procya prāṇabuddhīti coccaret avasthāsu manaseti vācā ca karmaṇeti ca śiṅā yat smṛtamityetad yaduktaṃ yat kṛtantathā ṅe'ntāṃ samarpitaṃ tāraṃ tat sadātmā'rpaṇe manuḥ abhyukṣya pūjayed vahniṃ gandhapuṣpādinā sudhīḥ ekaikāmāhutiṃ hutvā tattanmantreṇa deśikaḥ anenāgniñca saṃprārthya kṣamasveti visarjayet

naimittike ca paridhīn nitye naiva ca saṃdahet iti śrīpūrṇānandaparamahaṃsaviracite śrītattvacintāmaṇau aṣṭamaḥ prakāśaḥ atha prasaṅgād vakṣyāmi homadravyasya lakṣaṇam mūḍhasyāpi ca mūkasya śilārūpasya nānyathā yoṣitaḥ sakalā vaśyā dāsībhūtā bhavanti hi hutvā lakṣaṃ vaśīkuryād viṃśatiṃ dharaṇībhujām madhvaktakaravīraistu sāṅgaṃ bhūpaṃ vaśaṃ nayet pāṭalairyūthikākundaiḥ śatapatraiśca jātibhiḥ sarvasaubhāgyamāpnoti buddhyā ca vākpatirbhavet raktotpalairjagad vaśyaṃ rājāno vaśagāḥ kṣaṇāt śvetotpalaiḥ śriyaṃ vācaṃ labhate havanād dhruvam vakulasya phalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ saubhāgyaṃ jāyate mahat havanānmaraṇañcaiva mantriṇā vijitaṃ bhavet prāpnoti mantrī mahatīṃ stambhayejjagatīmimām sarve lokā vaśāstasya bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥ durgopasargaśamanaṃ palatrimadhuhomataḥ khecaro jāyate rātrau kṛtvā homaṃ catuṣpathe mahārāṣṭraṃ mahādurgaṃ samastaṃ vaśamānayet āyurdhanamathā'rogyaṃ samṛddhirjāyate nṛṇām dadhimākṣikayogeṇa saubhāgyaṃ dhanamāpnuyāt vaśayedduṣṭalokāṃśca havanānnātra saṃśayaḥ dadhnā'ṣṭaśatakaṃ hutvā'kālamṛtyuṃ vaśaṃ nayet madhvājyaguggulenaiva rājendraṃ vaśamānayet rogahantā lokahantā mṛtyuhantā bhaved dhruvam tilājyahomamātreṇa sarvakarmāṇi sādhayet

guggulasya ca homena sarvaduḥkhāni nāśayet raktacandanahomena vaśyā hi puruṣāḥ striyaḥ kastūrīhavanānmantrī sarve vaśyā bhavanti hi śarkarāguḍahomena sarvakāryāṇi sādhayet ghṛtapāyasahomena vaśīkuryānmahāgrahān trailokyaṃ vaśamāpnoti dhānyavṛddhirbhavet kila pūrṇadāḍimbahomena vaśīkuryānmahāgrahān mātuluṅgaphalairhomāt kṣatriyā vaśagā dhruvam kuṣmāṇḍaphalahomena śūdrā vaśyā bhavanti hi drākṣāphalaiḥ siddhayo'ṣṭau lakṣahomānna saṃśayaḥ vaśyāstu daśasaṃkhyātā bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥ vaśyā viṃśatisaṃkhyātā bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥ lakṣamātreṇa mantrajño rājatulyo bhaved dhruvam catuḥsamudraparyantāṃ medinīṃ vaśamānayet ikṣudaṇḍaiḥ sukhāvāptistadvaśā rājakanyakāḥ puṣpaṃ samagraṃ juhuyāt kamalenāpi puṣkalam śatasaṃkhyāstilāścaiva rājikāḥ śatasaṃkhyayā cullukārddhaṃ tathā kṣīramannaṃ grāsamitaṃ bhavet manaḥpriyaiśca khaṇḍaiśca phalairbhavati niścayāt panasaiḥ phalagarbhasthaiścūtairmadhuyutairhunet drākṣāphalaṃ samastaṃ syānnāgaraṅgañca kharjuram guñjāsamānaṃ karpūraṃ kastūrī ghusṛṇaṃ tathā manaḥpriyāṇi sarvāṇi phalāni havanāya ca prakārāntaramucyate bhavanti karṣamāṇañca guḍaṃ palārddhamātrakam

mātuluṅgaṃ catuḥkhaṇḍaṃ panasaṃ daśadhā smṛtam tridhā khaṇḍaṃ phalaṃ vailvaṃ kapitthaṃ khaṇḍitaṃ dvidhā vrīhayo muṣṭimātrāḥ syū raktamāṣā yavā api tintiḍībījamānāni marīcānyapi viṃśatiḥ anukte tu havirdravye tilājyaṃ havirucyate athārimantratyāgasya vidhiḥ samyak pracakṣyate aśeṣaduḥkhanāśāya deśikaḥ pravaraṃ vidhim maṇḍale sthāpayed vidvān pūrayettaṃ jalaiḥ śubhaiḥ sakalīkṛtya saṃpūjyā'varaṇāni prapūjayet hutvā vilomamantreṇa sarpiṣā gorapi dvijaḥ vidikṣu dikṣu ca tathā vakṣyamāṇairmanukramaiḥ namastubhyaṃ gṛhāṇemaṃ puṣpadhūpādikaṃ valim (1) gṛhāṇa puṣpadhūpādivalimenaṃ supūjitam (2) valiṃ dattaṃ gṛhāṇemaṃ suprīto varado bhava (3) gṛhāṇa valipūjādi mayā bhaktyā niveditam (4) bhaktyā niveditāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhītvā prītimāpnuhi (5) mayā prayuktaṃ vidhivad gṛhāṇa valimādarāt (6) puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ prītau bhavetāṃ varadau mama (7) pūjitaḥ puṣpadhūpādyaiḥ prāto bhava vibhūtaye (8) gṛhāṇa sarvavighnān me nivartaya namo'stu te (9) pūjitaḥ parayā bhaktyā bhava tvaṃ sukhado mama (10) mantreṇa viparītena puṣpa-dhūpopacārakaiḥ tatastu prārthayed vidvān pūjitāṃ mantradevatām tena me manasaḥ kṣobhaṃ vinivartaya sarvadā tanotu mama kalyāṇaṃ pāvanī bhaktireva te

kalasopari saṃsthāpya bhaktyā paramayā punaḥ snāyāt pūjitakumbhasthatoyairmantramayaiḥ śubhaiḥ tanmadhye mantrapatrañca nikṣipyātha prapūjayet nikṣipeddaśa viprāṃśca yathāśaktyā prapūjayet naśyantyeva na sandehaḥ kramāccittaprasannatā mālinīvijayasyeti matametadudīritam navamaḥ prakāśaḥ sarvaśāstramayīṃ devīṃ sarvakāraṇarūpiṇīm brahmaviṣṇubhavairvandyāṃ śrīmattripurasundarīm tatrādau pañcamī vidyā kathyate bhuvi durlabhā nityā ca muktidā śuddhā sukhadā duḥkhanāśinī pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśasambhavam tejo rudrasya rudrāṇī vāyurīśasya ceśvarī pañcadevātmakaṃ pañca pañcamī-pañcaśaktayaḥ tṛtīyā bhagamālā ca turyā tripurasundarī nityā ca pañcamī śaktiḥ paraṃbrahmasvarūpiṇī tasmāddevyāśca tadrūpamudayāstavivarjitam sthūlasūkṣmavibhedena paraṃbrahmasvarūpiṇī saiva viśveśvarī devī vyāpakatvena saṃsthitā śambhunā cintyate sā tu tatprasādācchivo vibhuḥ brahmatvaṃ brahmaṇā prāptaṃ viṣṇutvaṃ viṣṇunā svayam (p. 285) surāsuramunīndrāṇāṃ mahattvaṃ tatprasādataḥ so'pi cābhūt svayaṃ kartā śivatulyo mahāmuniḥ atiguhyatamā vidyā brahmavidyaiva kevalā gurubhakto jitākṣaśca pañcamīṃ samupāsayet

sarvadevamayī śuddhā sarvaśaktimayī śubhā pṛthivyāṃ mānavaḥ śreṣṭho yadi jānāti pañcamīm sa bhavet khecaro nityamabhyāsānnātra saṃśayaḥ sa pūjyaḥ sarvalokeṣu sa devo na tu mānuṣaḥ kalpanāśuddhabhāvena sarvasiddhiṃ labhettu saḥ kāraṇānandarūpeṇa pañcamīṃ samupāsayet pañca kūṭaprakāreṇa trikūṭā vāgbhavāditaḥ naro lakṣaṃ japtvā suragurusamānaḥ sa bhavati kāmaṃ śambhusamīraṇendragirijābījaṃ krameṇoddharet śambhuṃ manmathaśakrasomasahitaṃ devīṃ krameṇoddharet rājaśrīcaraṇāravindayugalā pūrṇenduśuddhānanā pañcakūṭātmikā vidyā pañcapañcākṣarī bhavet jñātvā yat sādhayennityamasādhyamapi bhūtale evaṃ kūṭatrayeṇāpi vidyā saubhāgyarūpiṇī durlabhā sarvalokeṣu sarvasaubhāgyasundarī japtvā'nandamayo bhūtvā sarvakāmamupālabhet ākarṣaṇakarī vidyā cittāhlādanakāriṇī mahābhogakarī vidyā mahāsiddhipradāyinī yasyā ārādhanaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtale añjanaṃ guṭikādiśca yā yā vidyā sudurlabhā aṇimāsiddhayaḥ santi vaśyā bhavanti devatāḥ dūrādeva palāyante darśanāt sādhakasya ca jīvanmuktaḥ sādhakendraḥ kartā hartā bhaveddivi ekākṣareṇa kathitaṃ brahmavidyaiva kevalam sā devī pañcamī vidyā sarvādhārasvarūpiṇī

nānyat parataraṃ kiñcid vidyate bhuvanatraye sarvaṃ tat paramaṃ rūpaṃ tasyā eva na saṃśayaḥ sahasraikapramāṇena kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtale yogātmā sa bhavenmukto nānābhogena kevalam yasmai kasmai na dātavyā vidyā paramadurlabhā dātavyā pañcamī vidyā putrāya prāṇadāya ca paramānandanirvāhaṃ kuloḍḍīśe prakāśitam tadadhaḥ śakrabījantu yojayed bhuvaneśvarīm eṣā vidyā mahāvidyā dharmakāmārthamokṣadā aparañca pravakṣyāmi kulāmṛtamataṃ param eṣā guhyā parā jñeyā puruṣārthaphalapradā sārāt sārataraṃ kūṭaṃ śrīkrame tu prakāśitam indrabījaṃ śivaḥ paścānmṛgātmā tadanantaram vāgbhavaṃ pūrvamuditaṃ kāmarājaṃ trikūṭakam atiyatnena goptavyā mātṛmaithunavat sadā prabhutvaṃ śambhunā prāptaṃ yasyā dhyānaprasādataḥ sākṣād brahmasvarūpaṃ hariharamunibhiḥ sevitaṃ sarvasāram gopyā sarvaiḥ prayatnādabhimataphaladā naiva vācyā parasmin mātṛmaithunavannityaṃ gopayet sādhakottamaḥ śrīkrame ca mahātantre śivena parikīrtitam kevalā citkalā nityā nityānandasvarūpiṇī aprakāśyā mahāvidyā gopanīyā prayatnataḥ varaṃ putraṃ dhanaṃ rājyaṃ deyaṃ neyaṃ kadācana tadā jñātvā kulīnāya śiṣyāya prāṇadāya ca likhitvā darśayed bhūmau na ca karṇe prakāśayet

tataḥ svātmaviśuddhyarthaṃ lakṣamekaṃ japed guruḥ anyasaṃsmaraṇādduḥkhaṃ yoginīśāpamālabhet kimadhikam paraṃ sādhyamasyāḥ sarvatra yad bhavet anayā sadṛśaṃ jñānaṃ sarvatantreṣu durlabham tṛtīyaṃ śaktikūṭaṃ syāttryakṣarī tripurā parā anayā sadṛśī vidyā nāsti lokatraye yataḥ eṣā pañcadaśī devī saubhāgyaiṣā ca pañcamī eṣā tattvaparā jñeyā saptaviṃśākṣarī tathā kāmakalā turīyā ca śaktistu sārddhamātṛkā ekākṣareṇa kathitā brahmavidyaiva kevalā jyotīrūpeṇa sā devī paraṃtejaḥsvarūpiṇī varṇāni vividhānyeva tasyā bhedāni tattvataḥ tasyā bhedānyanekāni tejāṃsi ca guṇāni ca saiva viśveśvarī devī svataḥ kaivalyadāyinī sāmānyāḥ siddhirahitā jñātavyā deśikottamaiḥ evameṣā samutpannā mahātripurasundarī tasyā rūpañca taj jñeyaṃ jagad vyāpya vijṛmbhate naro japtvā siddhaḥ prabhavati mahāmokṣapadavīm arihā siddhidā nityā trailokye cātidurlabhā datte ca siddhihāniḥ syāt kruddhā bhavati sundarī manurvimṛṣya dātavyo jyeṣṭhaputrāya dhīmate tena vīryavatī vidyā bhāryā kulabadhūriva śuddhā sarvatra vijñeyā sarvadoṣavivarjitā vāgbhavaṃ gaganaṃ hādyamuṣmā bhautikabindumān etattu vāgbhavaṃ kūṭaṃ sarvapakṣeṣu śobhanam

śukrātmā bhāskaro'nanto devarājaḥ śivastathā manusargau tataḥ śaktirbhānurindro maheśvarī mantranirṇayatantre ca śivena parikīrtitā vāgbhavaṃ vijayā māyā brahmā śakraśca pārvatī tato hādyaṃ manusargavibhūṣitam aṣṭādaśākṣarī vidyā mahātripurasundarī sarvānte haṃsasaṃyuktā tadā viṃśākṣarī bhavet manunā sargavān bhṛguḥ kāmabījaṃ lakṣmīrbhṛguḥ prajāpatiḥ nārīṇāṃ mohinī devī jagatkāraṇarūpiṇī bhago māyā tato brahmā śakrastu bhuvaneśvarī bhuvaneśyā maheśaśca śaktirbrahmeśa indrakaḥ bhuvaneśyā netramastraṃ śaktirmādana eva ca eṣā parāpi vijñeyā tattvarūpā maheśvarī nāsti vidyā samā cāsyā balavīryasamanvitā kāmendrau ca mahāmāyā vāgbhavaṃ kūṭamuttamam śaktikūṭaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat śaktiḥ kāmaḥ sahasrākṣo mahāmāyā tataḥ param savīryā siddhidā nityā vidyā sarvārthasiddhidā bhairavaṃ bindumālī ca brahmā śakraḥ sureśvarī mahāmāyā vāgbhavañca mānmathaṃ sargavān bhṛguḥ śaktikūṭaṃ likhettataḥ bhṛgurbrahmā sahasrākṣo mahāmāyā tadantaram saptaviṃśākṣarī vidyā mahātripurasundarī ramate sakalāṃ nārīṃ japtvā yāti surālayam

manoḥ smaraṇamātreṇa vrajedbhagavataḥ padam eṣā vidyā prayatnena guptā grantheṣu koṭiṣu bhāṣitā śaṅkareṇaiva sālaṅkārā mahodayā gopanīyā prayatnena na deyā yasya kasyacit haro bhṛgurdivānātho vajradhṛg bhuvaneśvarī kāmabījadvayañcaiva vāgbhavaṃ ca humātmakam śaktikūṭamathocyate mahāmāyā tataḥ paścāddhaṃsabījaṃ tadantike bālābījatrayañcaiva jhiṇṭīśo bindumālinī pāśaḥ śaktirmādanañca śūnyendrau bhuvaneśvarī kāmarājamidaṃ puṇyaṃ kathitaṃ sarvadurlabham mahāvidyeśvarī paścād vidyā saṃhāriṇī bhavet eṣā sā sundarī vidyā śatrūṇāṃ prāṇanāśinī sthitirūpā mahāvidyā sādhakāya varapradā na cāsyāḥ sadṛśī kācit triṣu lokeṣu vidyate vahnibījaṃ tataḥ paścād bhautikena samanvitam etattu vāgbhavaṃ kūṭaṃ sarvapakṣeṣu durlabham prāṇau madanaśūnyau ca devarājaḥ sureśvarī sauḥkāraṃ śivaśaktī ca vahnibījaṃ manusvaram sargacandraṃ nādayuktaṃ śaktibrahmendramāyayā (p. 313) sṛṣṭirūpā mahāvidyā sārabhūtā mahodayā śivātmā tatparo vahnirbhautikenendunā yutaḥ etattu vāgbhavaṃ kūṭaṃ kathitaṃ sarvadurlabham etajjaptvā mahābījaṃ kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtale vāgīśaṃ sparddhate vākyaiḥ sarvajñastu prajāyate

vāgbhavaṃ mānmathaṃ bījaṃ sauḥkāraṃ bindumālinī brahmā śakraśca vahniśca māyārddhendusamanvitaḥ etatkūṭasya māhātmyaṃ śatakoṭisuvistaram helayā tridivaṃ prāpya modate śambhunā saha vāñchitaṃ labhate kāmaṃ satyameva na saṃśayaḥ bālāyāḥ śaktikūṭañca śaktistu kamalāsanaḥ śaktikūṭamidaṃ puṇyaṃ puruṣārthapravartakam na deyā kasyacit sthāne sugopyā durlabhā parā brahmā śivendrau śaktiśca mahāmāyā tataḥ parā eṣā pañcadaśī bhāṣā sākṣāt tripurasundarī evameṣā mahāvidyā mahātripurasundarī bṛhacchīkramatantrasya matametadudīritam yasyā ārādhanenaiva kāmaḥ sarvāṅgasundaraḥ sarvaśāstramayī vidyā sarvasaubhāgyasundarī śāktaśāmbhavabhedena kathayāmi sudurlabhām dattvā māyāṃ tadante bhajati suragaṇo mantramenaṃ prasiddham ṛtuvarṇātmakaṃ kūṭaṃ kāmarājantu madhyamam evaṃ kūṭātmikā devī tryakṣarī tripureśvarī jñeyā sā kīlitā vidyā siddhidā na hi bhūtale etatkāraṇavṛttāntaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ āsīcca nagare nityaṃ bhikṣārthī vicareddvijaḥ jalābhilāṣiṇaṃ vipraṃ nijagāda sarastaṭe vilokya sahasā vipro natvā taṃ daṇḍadhāriṇam dattvāśīrvādaṃ sannyāsī bhūyo brāhmaṇamabravīt mantraikaṃ kathayāmi tvāṃ snānaṃ kuru vidhānataḥ

padmapatre jalaṃ kṛtvā padmapuṣpeṇa cārcaya yathā jñānavidhānena guruṇā kathito manuḥ kartavyaṃ puṇyatīrtheṣu parvateṣu nadīṣu vā bhūpatirbhūtale bhūtvā cānte svargaṃ gamiṣyasi tapaḥsthāne tato gatvā punastaddharmamācaret ekacittaḥ sadā bhūyo japenmantraṃ vidhānataḥ anekakālaparyantaṃ na labdhvā vāñchitaṃ phalam na dṛṣṭvā kāryasampattiṃ mahāduḥkhī babhūva saḥ etat kaṣṭaṃ samāsādya vadan vipro viṣādavān sārathirnāsti me'raṇye mahāduḥkhe'pyupasthite nirdayaḥ pārvatānātho nirdayā karuṇāmayī sa didṛkṣurvidhātāraṃ gahanaṃ vanamāviśat yakṣarākṣasakuṣmāṇḍa-ḍākinīgaṇasaṃvṛtāḥ balahīno vaṭurbhūtvābhartsayat kamalāsanam vaṭunā duḥkhitenāpi sarastenāvalokitam nānāvṛkṣataṭākrāntaṃ nānāpakṣivibhūṣitam brahmoddeśe tanuṃtyaktvā kṣipraṃ yāmi yamālayam brāhmaṇaṃ rūpamāsthāya gatavān viprasannidhau kastvaṃ kathaṃ vane cāsmin hetunā kena vāgataḥ kutaḥ kamāgataḥ ko vā manuṣyo vātha dānavaḥ avyaktacakṣuṣā vipraḥ pratyuttaraṃ dadāti saḥ dvijasya vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmā vākyamabhāṣataḥ anekakālaparyantaṃ narasaṅgavivarjitaḥ tvāṃ vilokya viśeṣeṇa madīyaṃ dahyate vapuḥ etadduḥkhamabhiprāpya kathamatrāpi tiṣṭhasi

taduddeśe vadhaṃ kṛtvā yāsyāmi dharmaśāśvatam vṛthā'śā kriyate vipra yā na syāt pṛthivītale tiṣṭhanti sarvadā devāḥ kadācit svargaśāsane idaṃ śarīramādāya gaccha tvaṃ nijaveśmani gaccha gaccha mahābhāga tūrṇameva nijālayam tadbhoktavyaṃ mayā sākṣāt kimetadvacanena vai nivṛttirme tadā jñeyā anyathā nidhanaṃ kila prapalāyya gatastasmād yatna devo maheśvaraḥ punaḥ paramayā bhaktyā nijagāda pitāmahaḥ brāhmaṇasya vadhenaiva vināśo me bhaviṣyati pratyuvāca vidhātāraṃ kiṃ vadhaṃ brūhi me dhruvam kenopāyena deveśa tadvadho na bhavenmayi jagāmāvyaktarūpeṇa brāhmaṇasya ca sannidhau kathaṃ tyajasi dehaṃ tvaṃ kāntamatyantasundaram mattaḥ śṛṇu viśeṣaṃ tvamutkaṭaṃ narakaṃ vrajet vicintyaitanmahādeva upaviśya punarvadan māṃ vilokya mahāraṇye na dadāsyuttaraṃ katham devadevaṃ jagannāthaṃ tapasvirūpadhāriṇam akhilaṃ sarvavṛttāntaṃ kathitaṃ taddvijena tu sadayaḥ pārvatīnātho brāhmaṇāya vaco'bravīt gṛhītaduṣṭamantreṇa hanyate siddhiruttamā samastaṃ brūhi bhagavan śṛṇomi tvatprasādataḥ yadi tvaṃ priyamākāṅkṣī vipro'si paramārthataḥ tadā matto manuṃ gṛhṇa bhuktimuktipradāyakam brāhmaṇāya susiddhā sā sarvābhīṣṭapradāyinī

(p. 324) evamukto vibhustasya antardhāno'bhavacca saḥ labhetābhīṣṭasiddhantu satyameva suniścitam varaṃ gṛhāṇa vipra tvaṃ manasā vāñchitaṃ yathā vareṇātaḥpareṇāpi phalaṃ kiṃ me bhaviṣyati adhunā bhūpatirbhūtvā rājyasaukhyamavapsyasi ataḥ paraṃ manuṃ japtvā śacīpatirbhaviṣyasi caṇḍikāyāḥ prasādena sahasā sa nṛpo'bhavat labhate vāñchitāṃ siddhiṃ mantrāt kāryaṃ na sidhyati kalpakoṭiśatenāpi siddhistasya na jāyate daśamaḥ prakāśaḥ
